input: driver torque sensor, steering angle sensor, motor angle or rack position proxy
output: plausibility residual, offset trend, noise / drift indicator
comparison_basis: same key cycle, recent self-history, learned center, paired sensor consistency, temperature band
normal_or_baseline: within electrical range and no hard plausibility fault, but residual/noise/offset trend differs from recent or calibrated norm
existing_monitor: range check, dual sensor plausibility, stuck / open / short, hard DTC threshold
deviation_candidate: within-range offset drift, noise increase, intermittent mismatch below DTC threshold, temperature-correlated residual growth
additional_log_trigger: save extended snapshot when residual trend exceeds soft threshold repeatedly without DTC
diagnostic_use: decide whether to read sensor plausibility history before replacing EPS or blaming external input
quality_feedback_use: return field pattern of near-threshold sensor disagreement by temperature/use condition
customer_explanation_use: explain that signal remains in range but consistency trend needs observation; do not call it failure
existing_monitor_gap: existing monitor may already cover safety-relevant plausibility; added value only if trend below DTC is useful for diagnosis
proceed_signal: Proceed if soft residual trend changes service reading order or quality feedback
hold_or_stop_signal: Stop if hard plausibility monitor already captures all useful cases or trend is not stable
what_not_to_claim: 故障時期、交換時期、sensor root cause、安全保証を言わない

input: assist command, phase current, DC bus voltage, rotor position, motor speed, temperature
output: current response, torque response proxy, current ripple, response delay
comparison_basis: same assist command band, voltage band, temperature band, steering speed band, self-history
normal_or_baseline: response follows command within control tolerance and no inverter DTC
existing_monitor: current limit, over-current, over/under-voltage, phase fault, thermal protection, control error hard threshold
deviation_candidate: small increase in required current for same command band, delayed response, ripple increase, thermal-sensitive response shift
additional_log_trigger: log command/current/voltage/temp snapshot when response residual repeats under comparable voltage/temp band
diagnostic_use: prioritize inverter/motor response context before component judgment and before external-load assumptions
quality_feedback_use: identify field pattern of response margin loss or operating condition sensitivity
customer_explanation_use: explain that command-response margin changed under defined context; not proof of wear or failure
existing_monitor_gap: existing current/thermal monitors may already trigger before useful soft deviation; external steering load can contaminate signal
proceed_signal: Proceed if comparable-condition residual can be defined without E2E external load inference
hold_or_stop_signal: Hold if external load dominates and no internal comparison can be trusted
what_not_to_claim: 摩耗、寿命、交換時期、外乱原因特定を言わない

input: ECU supply voltage, DC bus voltage, reset counter, voltage dip duration, assist command during dip
output: voltage stability class, near-reset context, assist limitation context
comparison_basis: same vehicle state or key cycle, voltage band, event duration, recurrence across cycles
normal_or_baseline: voltage within allowed range most of the time, no permanent power DTC
existing_monitor: under/over-voltage DTC, reset detection, power supply fault, brownout protection
deviation_candidate: repeated short voltage dips near assist limitation, transient voltage instability below DTC persistence threshold
additional_log_trigger: log voltage dip waveform summary, assist mode, reset counter, DTC status, key cycle recurrence
diagnostic_use: read power context before interpreting reduced assist as EPS component issue
quality_feedback_use: feedback recurring near-threshold power events that correlate with assist limitation
customer_explanation_use: explain that power context may affect assist availability; not EPS failure proof
existing_monitor_gap: existing voltage DTC may be enough if soft dips are not stored or not actionable
proceed_signal: Proceed if soft voltage context changes diagnostic reading order and can be stored
hold_or_stop_signal: Hold if no voltage history or event persistence is available
what_not_to_claim: 電源原因断定、EPS無罪断定、交換時期、安全保証を言わない

input: motor temp, inverter temp, ECU temp, estimated winding temp, assist limit state, cool-down behavior
output: thermal margin, derating proximity, recovery slope
comparison_basis: same ambient/temp band, assist demand band, previous cool-down history, calibration threshold distance
normal_or_baseline: no over-temp DTC; derating may be normal protection, but margin/recovery differs from self-history
existing_monitor: over-temperature DTC, thermal protection threshold, assist limit state, recovery after cool-down
deviation_candidate: faster temperature rise for comparable internal demand, repeated near-derating, slow recovery, frequent soft limit entry
additional_log_trigger: log temp/margin/assist limit/cool-down snapshot when near-derating repeats
diagnostic_use: read thermal context and recovery before component replacement or customer explanation
quality_feedback_use: feed recurring near-derating patterns into design/quality/evaluation review
customer_explanation_use: explain normal protection vs observation-needed repeated near-derating; not lifetime prediction
existing_monitor_gap: existing thermal protection may already explain event; added value requires recurrence/margin history
proceed_signal: Proceed if margin/recovery history creates useful explanation or evaluation feedback
hold_or_stop_signal: Hold if it only says thermal protection worked as designed
what_not_to_claim: 寿命短縮、交換時期、安全保証、使用者責任断定を言わない

input: external signal validity, timeout, counter, alive signal, vehicle speed/yaw/ADAS request validity, fallback state
output: validity stability, fallback entry context, signal dependency snapshot
comparison_basis: same network state, signal source, dependency list, previous validity history
normal_or_baseline: signal may be valid at event time but history shows intermittent invalid/timeout below hard fault threshold
existing_monitor: timeout DTC, bus-off, invalid value DTC, signal substitution/fallback, communication fault threshold
deviation_candidate: intermittent invalid, delayed update, repeated fallback entry, mismatch between signal validity and steering message
additional_log_trigger: log dependency signal status, timeout counters, fallback mode, steering message, related DTC
diagnostic_use: read external signal/fallback context before EPS internal fault judgment
quality_feedback_use: identify recurring dependency instability that drives customer complaints or service confusion
customer_explanation_use: explain EPS response depends on external signal validity; not proof external ECU is root cause
existing_monitor_gap: existing communication DTC may already identify hard faults; soft intermittent validity must affect output to matter
proceed_signal: Proceed if dependency snapshot prevents misdiagnosis or improves customer explanation
hold_or_stop_signal: Stop if signal dependency cannot be defined by EPS supplier
what_not_to_claim: 外部ECU root cause、EPS問題なし、交換時期、安全保証を言わない
